name: honduras-income-tax
description: Use this skill for Honduras personal income tax (Impuesto Sobre la Renta, ISR) of resident individuals and self-employed professionals for tax year 2026. It gives the SAR 2026 progressive scale (exempt to L228,324.32, then 15%, 20% and 25%), the art. 13 deductions (L40,000 flat, L80,000 over 65), the 13th and 14th month exemption, the 10% dividend and capital gains taxes, the 10% housing rent tax, the 12.5% art. 50 retention on fees, the four pagos a cuenta, filing of Form 102 by 30 April and the Codigo Tributario penalties. Trigger phrases include ISR Honduras, Declaracion Jurada 102, tabla progresiva 2026, renta neta gravable, pagos a cuenta, retencion 12.5% honorarios and SAR Oficina Virtual. Companies go to hn-corporate-income-tax; employer withholding to honduras-payroll.
